verdicts.reason: Both share the same faults: the logo is blown up into the dominant focal point, overpowering the headline. The original's dark header bar is left as a stray rectangle in the top-right corner, and the orange divider floats alone at the right edge. The 'Reserve a Case' button is tiny and crammed onto one line with 'Ships late June' and unreadable legal text, so the CTA is buried. A is slightly worse because its oversized logo badge presses against the left and bottom canvas edges and its body copy sits tighter on the CTA row. B insets the logo a little more and gives the button marginally more room.
